title: China's Bilibili relaunches its international app and plans an English-language site; it has been pushing MrBeast and others to post on its Chinese site (J.D. Capelouto/Semafor)
summary: J.D. Capelouto / Semafor: China's Bilibili relaunches its international app and plans an English-language site; it has been pushing MrBeast and others to post on its Chinese site — THE SCOOP — China's equivalent to YouTube is making a play for the rest of the world and courting non-Chinese creators to boost its appeal.
